newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy police arrest suspected anarchists.
newsitem.headline: Italy police arrest suspected anarchists.

text.p: Italian police said on Tuesday they had arrested 10 suspected members of an anarchist group on weapons, terrorism and other charges.
The paramilitary Carabinieri police force said the arrests and the searches of some 50 homes and offices were part of a nationwide sweep involving 300 officers.
Police said the arrests stemmed from probes of a string of attempted bombings, robberies and other crimes in several Italian cities including Rome, Florence and Milan.
